title: 48% of Google Cloud Revenue Next Year Could Come From Just 2 Companies That Have Still Never Turned a Profit
excerpt: A prominent AI skeptic is making the case that the explosive revenue growth powering Google Cloud, AWS, and Azure traces back to just two companies that have...
content_html:
AJ Tiarsmith

Mon, August 10, 2026 at 4:51 AM PDT 4 min read

Quick Read

  • UBS estimates OpenAI and Anthropic will drive 48% of GOOGL Cloud revenue next year, while MSFT's Intelligent Cloud saw 69% of its growth from OpenAI alone.

  • Ed Zitron warns OpenAI's $20.9 billion 2025 losses and a delayed IPO expose hyperscalers to a $1.6 trillion annual infrastructure demand gap.

  • It sounds nuts, but SoFi1 is giving new Active Invest users up to $3,000 in stock for a limited time, and all it takes is a $50 deposit to get started.2 See for yourself (Sponsor)

On a Bloomberg Businessweek segment that aired August 7, 2026, Ed Zitron, CEO of EZ Primary Research and one of the more vocal AI skeptics in financial media, made a claim that reframes how investors should think about hyperscaler cloud growth. Citing UBS estimates that 27% of Google Cloud's revenue this year comes from OpenAI and Anthropic, rising to 48% next year, totaling over $124 billion, Zitron argued that the AI boom powering Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOGL), Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT), and Amazon (NASDAQ:AMZN) is dangerously narrow.

Zitron's thesis: what looks like broad, diversified enterprise demand for AI compute is, in his view, circular financing concentrated in two unprofitable private companies that, as he put it, "do not pay their bills out of existing cash flow."

The Concentration Numbers Across the Three Hyperscalers

Google Cloud is the epicenter of the argument. The segment posted $24.768 billion in Q2 2026 revenue, growing 82% year-over-year, its fifth consecutive quarter of acceleration. Alphabet spent $44.924 billion on capex in the quarter, more than double the prior year, and raised roughly $70 billion through combined equity and debt financing, per its Q2 8-K filing. Free cash flow turned negative at -$5.855 billion, and the buyback was suspended.

SoFi Active Invest is offering a limited-time promotion. Open an account, fund it with $50 or more, and you could receive up to $3,000 in complimentary stock for Active Invest accounts. See for yourself by clicking here now. (Sponsor)

Zitron's argument is that this spending is being underwritten by a customer base most investors misunderstand. At AWS, Barclays puts exposure to those same two customers at 13% this year, rising to 18% next year. At Microsoft, Zitron reported that 69% of Microsoft Intelligent Cloud's year-over-year growth in 2025 came from OpenAI alone, and without it that segment would have grown just 8% year-over-year. He also cited reporting from The Information that 89% of the largest AI companies' revenue comes from OpenAI and Anthropic.

在 2026 年 8 月 7 日播出的《彭博商业周刊》栏目中，EZ Primary Research 首席执行官、财经媒体中最直言不讳的人工智能怀疑论者之一 Ed Zitron 提出了一项主张，重新定义了投资者应如何看待超大规模云增长。 Zitron 援引瑞银集团的估计，今年谷歌云收入的 27% 来自 OpenAI 和 Anthropic，明年将上升至 48%，总计超过 1240 亿美元。Zitron 认为，为 Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOGL)、微软 (NASDAQ:MSFT) 和亚马逊 (NASDAQ:AMZN) 提供动力的人工智能热潮非常狭窄。

Zitron 的论点是：在他看来，看似广泛、多样化的企业对人工智能计算的需求实际上是循环融资集中在两家未盈利的私营公司，正如他所说，这些公司“不会用现有现金流来支付账单”。

三个超大规模的集中度数据

谷歌云是争论的中心。 该部门 2026 年第二季度收入为 247.68 亿美元，同比增长 82%，连续第五个季度加速增长。 根据其第二季度 8-K 文件，Alphabet 本季度资本支出为 449.24 亿美元，是上一年的两倍多，并通过股权和债务融资相结合筹集了约 700 亿美元。 自由现金流转负至-58.55亿美元，回购暂停。

Zitron 的论点是，这笔支出是由大多数投资者误解的客户群承保的。 巴克莱银行预计，今年 AWS 与这两个客户的接触比例为 13%，明年将上升至 18%。 在微软，Zitron 报告称，2025 年微软智能云同比增长的 69% 仅来自 OpenAI，如果没有 OpenAI，该细分市场的同比增长仅为 8%。 他还引用了 The Information 的报道称，最大的人工智能公司 89% 的收入来自 OpenAI 和 Anthropic。
